Each argument in a provider block is just a `key = value` line inside the braces — the same HCL syntax as every other block.
`skip_credentials_validation` and `skip_metadata_api_check` are top-level arguments of the provider block, at the same indentation level as `region`, not inside `endpoints`.
The `endpoints` block is a nested block inside `provider "aws" { … }`. Each line inside it follows the pattern `service_name = "url"` — for example `ec2 = "http://localhost:4566"`.
